name: Dwarfather’s Boon
body:
Your hand and mind are guided by The Dwarfather when it comes to working stone, gems or metal.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is the dwarfather, or a deity of the forge

Benefit: You gain a +2 divine bonus to any two Craft or Profession skills associated with working stone, gems or metal.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
